spec.title: Complemento · Disponibilidad del monitoreo (ventanas de 10 s con datos)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "sala_servidores")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lecturas_sala" and r._field == "temperatura")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if exists r._value and r._value > 0 then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value * 100.0}))
